title: Does RAG Introduce Unfairness in LLMs? Evaluating Fairness in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating RAG systems using scenario-based QA tasks constructed from the TREC 2022 Gender dataset, and measuring performance disparities (Group Disparity, Equalized Odds) in exact match accuracy and retrieval metrics (MRR) between female and male demographic groups.

Evaluating RAG systems using scenario-based QA tasks constructed from the TREC 2022 Location dataset, measuring exact match performance disparities between non-European (protected) and European (non-protected) groups.
Measuring normalized group disparity and false positive error rates between 'rich' and 'poor' categories using ambiguous and unambiguous question-answering scenarios from the BBQ dataset.
